objective: Verify that one accepted native Prompt 4 AI reply reaches a real downstream skill-effect path without changing production runtime.

requestTrace.implementation: real player.ai:makeReply plus native request-handler feasibility

downstreamEffectReplay.allowlistReason: safe active skill with one discard, one HP loss and bounded draw; no nested QA request
downstreamEffectReplay.skillEffectObservationNote: The global QA director is visited once per room player by the native trigger dispatcher; this is fan-out of one real effect, not four replay invocations.

limitations: This is one downstream replay for 1 of 18 skills; the other accepted replies were not applied through their full effect/event chains.
The replay proves request-to-effect reachability and the hs__kurou HP assertion, not tactical quality, win rate, reconnect/device behavior, release/rollback, or canary safety.

The runner used the explicit local unpinned diagnostic allowance because no release manifest was supplied; the public runtime MD5, native binary, browser dist and QA package hashes are retained for reproducibility.
The QA package was staged manually in an isolated temp runtime because the working-tree QA source was intentionally dirty; no commit, push, deploy or production runtime mutation was made.

upstreamPortability.guidance: Keep the hs__kurou replay as QA-only harness code; when upstream changes, port the request adapter, common SmartAI dispatcher, skill-specific addAI blocks, QA overlay and this bounded assertion separately. Do not overwrite whole upstream files.
